license_required.quote: No one shall practice podiatric medicine in this state unless duly licensed as provided by law.

issuing_authority.quote: the word "board" whenever used in this chapter means the state board of podiatric medicine.

moral_character_required.quote: he or she is of good moral character

degree_required.value: diploma or certificate of graduation from an approved college of podiatric medicine
degree_required.quote: has received a diploma or certificate of graduation from an approved college of podiatric medicine, recognized and approved by the board, having a minimum requirement of two years in an accredited college and four years in a recognized college of podiatric medicine

accrediting_body.quote: postgraduate study required shall be that presented by a college of podiatric medicine accredited by the American Podiatric Medical Association

required.quote: Every applicant for a permanent license as a podiatrist shall provide the state board of podiatric medicine with satisfactory evidence of having successfully completed such postgraduate training in hospitals and such other clinical and surgical settings as the board may prescribe by rule.

kind.value: postgraduate training in hospitals and other clinical and surgical settings
kind.quote: satisfactory evidence of having successfully completed such postgraduate training in hospitals and such other clinical and surgical settings as the board may prescribe by rule

exams.name: National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners examination
exams.notes: Also includes an examination of applicable Missouri statutes and regulations
exams.quote: The examination shall and will consist of the examination offered by the National Board of Podiatric Medical Examiners, as well as an examination of applicable Missouri statutes and regulations which shall be promulgated or approved by the board.

interval_years.quote: Each person applying for biennial license renewal shall complete the form and return it to the board on or before the renewal date

required.quote: Each applicant shall give with the application for biennial license renewal satisfactory evidence of completion of twenty-four hours of postgraduate study for each renewal period

hours_per_period.quote: satisfactory evidence of completion of twenty-four hours of postgraduate study for each renewal period since the last issuance or renewal of the license

period_years.quote: twenty-four hours of postgraduate study for each renewal period

available.quote: the board shall, under regulations established by the board, admit without examination legally qualified practitioners of podiatric medicine who hold licenses to practice podiatric medicine in any foreign country with equal educational requirements to the state of Missouri

requirements.value: Legally qualified practitioners holding licenses in a foreign country with equal educational requirements to Missouri, upon paying fees equivalent to license and examination fees.
requirements.quote: admit without examination legally qualified practitioners of podiatric medicine who hold licenses to practice podiatric medicine in any foreign country with equal educational requirements to the state of Missouri upon the applicant paying a fee equivalent to the license and examination fees required above

definition_quote.value: the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, with the exception of administration of general anesthetics, or amputation of the foot and with the further exception that the definitions shall not apply to bone surgery on children under the age of one year
definition_quote.quote: the diagnosis, medical, physical, or surgical treatment of the ailments of the human foot, with the exception of administration of general anesthetics, or amputation of the foot and with the further exception that the definitions shall not apply to bone surgery on children under the age of one year

methods_authorized.quote: to treat in any manner the human foot by medical, mechanical, or surgical methods

drug_authority.value: Use of drugs and medicines in the treatment of ailments of the human foot, excluding treatment of systemic diseases
drug_authority.quote: The use of such drugs and medicines in the treatment of ailments of the human foot shall not include the treatment of any systemic diseases.

anatomical_scope_upper_boundary.quote: the term "human foot" includes the ankle and the tendons which insert into the foot as well as the foot

amputation_authorized.quote: with the exception of administration of general anesthetics, or amputation of the foot

anesthesia_authority.quote: with the exception of administration of general anesthetics

ankle_surgery_authorized.quote: For surgery of the ankle only, the doctor of podiatric medicine licensed pursuant to this chapter shall either be board certified in foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or shall complete a twenty-four-month postgraduate clinical residency in podiatric surgery

ankle_surgery_residency_requirement.quote: shall either be board certified in foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery or shall complete a twenty-four-month postgraduate clinical residency in podiatric surgery

ankle_surgery_facility_requirement.quote: Surgical treatment of the ankle by a doctor of podiatric medicine shall be performed only in a licensed acute care hospital or a licensed ambulatory surgical clinic.

systemic_disease_treatment_excluded.quote: The use of such drugs and medicines in the treatment of ailments of the human foot shall not include the treatment of any systemic diseases.

board_certification_body.quote: board certified in foot and ankle surgery by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery

corrective_footwear_exemption.quote: This chapter shall further not apply to manufacturers of and dealers in shoes or corrective appliances for deformed feet; provided, however, that such manufacturers and dealers shall not be entitled to practice podiatric medicine, as in this chapter defined, unless duly licensed so to do as herein provided.
